title: Synthesis and application of polyoxometalate ionic liquid-coated ZnO nanoflowers for efficient extraction of tetracycline residues in food and environmental samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17063-17073
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00560H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zahra Nazar, Mohannad Al-Hmoud, Zahra Mohammadizadeh Tahroudi, Alexandra Suvorova, Muhammad Salman Khan, Ayed M. Binzowaimil, Hijaz Ahmad, Ahmad Irfan
For the first time, D-µSPE using a POM-IL@ZnO composite investigates residues of TCs in milk, honey, and water, showing better LOD and LOQ values. The POM-IL@ZnO sorbent-based D-µSPE approach presented considerable potency in food safety assessment.
